page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.xlarge is a local storage instance within the ecs.i1 family, designed for workloads requiring direct-attached solid-state disks alongside general-purpose compute ratios. The instance is powered by a dedicated 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It exposes 4 virtual CPUs derived from 2 physical cores utilizing hyper-threading, accompanied by 16.0 GB of system memory, providing an even allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. No dedicated graphics accelerators are included in this configuration.

A key architectural feature of the ecs.i1.xlarge is its bundled 223 GB local SSD storage, which sits in contrast to purely network-attached volume architectures. For network I/O, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps under KVM virtualization. Hardware instruction support covers standard cryptography and vector extensions including AES-NI, AVX, AVX-512F, and BMI2.

Benchmark results place the processing and memory subsystems primarily in the lower quartiles across standard evaluation suites. The instance produced a Geekbench single-core score of 951.0 and a multi-core score of 2047.0, with stress-ng single-core reaching 1104.68 and multi-core achieving 2936.81. Memory throughput shows uncached read bandwidth at 20.18 GB/sec and uncached write bandwidth at 18.44 GB/sec, placing large-block throughput in the bottom percentiles. In application-focused metrics, it sustained 2.98 million Redis SET operations per second and 2.5 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of integrated local SSD storage provides predictable local disk access without incurring separate per-gigabyte volume provisioning costs. However, overall compute throughput per core reflects older silicon generation performance, presenting a tradeoff between dedicated local disk availability and compute capability. The ecs.i1.xlarge is best suited for lightweight local databases, caching tiers, development environments, and moderate web serving operations requiring local scratch space.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.xlarge is a local-storage instance configured with 4 vCPUs (2 physical cores with hyper-threading) on a dedicated 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 x86_64 processor, 16.0 GB of memory, and a bundled 223 GB local SSD. It operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps under KVM virtualization and does not include GPU acceleration. Synthetic benchmarks reflect older-generation processing performance, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 2047.0, single-core score of 951.0, and an uncached memory read bandwidth of 20.18 GB/sec. Application testing yielded 2.98 million Redis SET operations per second and 2.5 GB/sec static web serving throughput. Offering integrated local solid-state storage without separate block-storage attachments, this instance fits development databases, secondary caching layers, and lightweight transactional services requiring direct-attached disk access.
